slides.title: Integration of Rajasthan: 7 stages
lines: The princely states of Rajputana joined in seven
30 March, the date Greater Rajasthan was formed in 1949,

slides.title: Stages 1 to 3 (1948)
lines: 3. United State of Rajasthan, 18 Apr 1948: Udaipur joins

slides.title: Stages 4 and 5 (1949)
lines: Bikaner and Jaisalmer join; Jaipur becomes capital
5. United State of Greater Rajasthan, 15 May 1949:

slides.title: Stages 6 and 7 (1950, 1956)
lines: 6. 26 Jan 1950: Sirohi joins (except Abu and Delwara)
Sunel Tappa join; Sironj goes to Madhya Pradesh
Rajasthan takes the shape we know today.

slides.title: Quadratic equations
lines: Standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0, with a ≠ 0

slides.title: Percentage basics
lines: x% of y is always equal to y% of x

slides.title: Successive change
lines: Two changes of a% and b% in a row give a net change of
a + b + (a × b) / 100  (use − for a decrease)

slides.title: Fundamental Rights: Part III
lines: Part III of the Constitution, Articles 12 to 35.
They can be enforced in court:
Article 32 lets a citizen go straight to the Supreme Court.

slides.title: Right to Property
lines: The 44th Amendment (1978) removed the Right to Property
It is now a legal right under Article 300A.
